tasks.title: Deterministic game core: schedule table, sim reducer, 4 entity FSMs, oil, scoring + golden traces
tasks.spec: package.json: add deps three@0.170.0, zustand@^5; devDeps vitest@^2, @types/three@0.170.0; add script "test": "vitest run". Keep react 19. src/core/ imports NOTHING outside src/core (no three, no DOM, no WebAudio) — enforce with a vitest source-scan test that greps core files for forbidden imports and Math.random. types.ts: SimState {tick,door,roomTick,player:{x,z,yaw,vel},oil,alive,checkpoint,deaths,runMs,doorLog,sconces:boolean[],entities:EntitySnapshot[],events:SimEvent[]}; Frame {mx,mz,yawD,interact}; SimEvent {type:'tell'|'death'|'door_open'|'banish'|'checkpoint'|'finale', entity?:'GAUNT'|'MURMUR'|'TALLY'|'CINDER', door, visible:boolean}; EntitySnapshot {kind,phase:string,dist?:number}. schedule.ts: export the EXACT 24-door table from architecture.md section 4 (door -> {archetype:'junction'|'guest'|'laundry'|'lounge'|'boiler'|'washroom', variant:'A'|'B', event:null|'GAUNT'|'MURMUR'|'TALLY'|'CINDER'|'FINALE', checkpoint:boolean}) plus per-door params: GAUNT alcove index + sweep path waypoints (2 waypoints per GAUNT door, room-local coords), CINDER sconce order {9:[0,1,2],15:[2,0,1],21:[1,2,0],24:[0,2,1]}, MURMUR spawn corner, TALLY fakeNum = expected+2. sim.ts: createInitialState(seed:number) + pure stepSim(state,frame):SimState — fixed dt=1/60, movement 2.2 m/s, per-room AABB collision list (authored in schedule.ts per archetype), door interact (frame.interact near door) advances door & sets doorLog=door+1, checkpoint doors {1,5,9,13,17,21} set checkpoint + emit checkpoint event, death -> alive=false + 90-tick freeze then respawn at checkpoint with oil 0.6 and block re-lock (roomTick reset replays events). oil.ts: drain 1/90 per tick-second lit, x4 during CINDER active, refill +0.35 cap 1 on oil cans/sconces, radius=2+6*oil. entities.ts: the 4 FSMs EXACTLY per architecture.md section 5 (GAUNT tell roomTick 60, sweep 6s @3.5 m/s, alcove+|vel|<0.2 survive; MURMUR 60-tick step, cone 25deg & oil>0.20 frozen, dist<1.5 death; TALLY fake door open = death, real = advance; CINDER blackout 3s/sconce, scratch-order relight, wrong resets, oil 0 -> early GAUNT death; FINALE door 24 concurrent, GAUNT tell roomTick 300). No Math.random anywhere; all variation from schedule.ts tables. scoring.ts: runCard {deepest_door,run_time_ms,deaths} + validateScore mirroring architecture.md section 10 rules (name regex ^[A-Za-z0-9 .'-]{1,12}$, door 1..24, runMs 10000..1800000, deaths 0..99). __tests__: schedule.test asserts the table (24 rows, events at 5,12,18 TALLY / 7,13,19 GAUNT / 9,15,21 CINDER / 10,16,22 MURMUR / 24 FINALE, checkpoints {1,5,9,13,17,21}); traces.ts exports 8 hand-written golden traces with hand-computed expected snapshots (gaunt7_survive, gaunt7_death_moving, murmur10_beam_walk, murmur10_oil_out_death, tally5_fake_door_death, cinder9_relight_order, checkpoint_respawn, finale24_survive) asserting exact {alive,door,oil band (0.05 buckets),entity phase} — WRITE TRACES FIRST, then code until green. sim.test runs every trace twice and asserts identical state (determinism proof).

tasks.title: PERF SPIKE + Three.js renderer: room builder, procedural textures, player controller, fixed-timestep loop, budget caps
tasks.spec: PERF SPIKE (week 2, before any polish): greybox 24-door run must hold 60fps on a mid iGPU — measured at orchestrator gate; this task guarantees it structurally via budget.ts. index.html: <title>HALLWAKE</title> (replaces 'HackathonFactory App'). App.tsx: mounts GameShell only. GameShell.tsx: creates canvas + Three scene, runs loop.ts (fixed dt=1/60 accumulator, max 5 catch-up steps then drop), calls stepSim from T1, pushes HUD snapshot to uiStore at 10Hz, exposes ?fps=1 dev meter. uiStore.ts MINIMAL zustand store {phase:'attract'|'playing'|'dead'|'run', hud snapshot, scores} — T4 replaces it. Hud.tsx: placeholder div showing door + oil numbers — T4 replaces it. scene.ts: WebGLRenderer, exponential fog #0a0a0e, PlayerRig camera, ONE SpotLight lantern (distance=2+6*oil), <=2 event PointLights, NO shadow maps anywhere (renderer.shadowMap.enabled=false), CSS vignette overlay div. roomBuilder.ts: 6 archetypes x2 variants from schedule.ts as box/extrude primitive data, merged per room via BufferGeometryUtils.mergeGeometries (StaticMerged + PropsMerged), only current + next room in scene, blob-AO dark discs under props, sconce/alcove emissive quads (emissive material, not lights), door numeral via canvas texture. textures.ts: procedural canvas textures only (wood grain, plaster, noise, wall lightmap gradient, door numerals) 256px props / 512px walls, cached by key, no external files. quality.ts: low/mid/high presets per architecture.md section 7. budget.ts: PURE function scenePlanFromRoom(room)->{drawCalls,dynamicLights,shadowMaps,triangles,textureBytes} — no WebGL. playerController.ts: Pointer Lock API, WASD, mouse look, E interact, Esc releases lock -> uiStore pause; Gamepad API (SHOULD): left stick move, right stick look, A/X interact; both emit the same Frame shape consumed by stepSim. Tests: budget.test asserts caps over ALL 24 rooms x2 variants: drawCalls<=150, dynamicLights<=3, shadowMaps===0, triangles<=120000, textureBytes<=8MB; textures.test asserts texture cache returns identical objects for same key and every texture is generated (no fetch).

tasks.title: Entity visuals + tell FX + WebAudio synth graph

Each factory returns {group, primitiveCount, update(simSnapshot, t)}; GameShell (T2) instantiates them from EntitySnapshot — do NOT edit GameShell; export a single mountEntities(scene, core) helper in fx.ts that T2's loop already can call via the events channel (fx.ts subscribes to SimEvents). Audio: graph.ts builds masterGain->DynamicsCompressor->destination + buses exactly per architecture.md section 8 (ambience brown-noise+55Hz sine, door thud, gaunt slam+hum, murmur whisper gain=facing dot, tally scratch+ping, cinder hiss+relight chime); AudioContext created lazily on first user input; NO audio files, everything OscillatorNode/noise buffers. cues.ts: PURE map SimEvent.type -> synth recipe (osc type, freq envelope, gain envelope) — no WebAudio imports in cues.ts. Tests: cues.test asserts every SimEvent type in T1's union has a recipe and recipes are serializable data; entityMeshes.test asserts each factory's primitiveCount within budget (<=12 primitives per entity) and group has no lights (lights come from scene budget only).

tasks.title: IP safety gate: scripts/ip-check.sh + CI workflow
tasks.spec: scripts/ip-check.sh per architecture.md section 12 EXACTLY: scan roots app/ scripts/ .github/ README*; exclude node_modules dist .venv .git data plan research; case-insensitive whole-word grep -rnwI for roblox lsplash rococo screech stonk amity dupe; case-sensitive whole-word grep -rnwI for DOORS Rush Figure Halt Glitch Jeff Eyes Blink; print file:line:match per hit; exit 1 on any hit else 0. --selftest: mktemp dir with a file containing 'Roblox' -> scan must exit 1; then full repo scan must exit 0; both required for exit 0. POSIX sh, no bashisms beyond [[ not allowed (use [ ]), works under Git Bash on Windows. .github/workflows/ci.yml: on push/PR, jobs: (1) frontend: actions/checkout, actions/setup-node node 20, working-directory app/frontend, npm ci, npm run build, npx vitest run; (2) backend: setup-python 3.12, pip install -r app/backend/requirements.txt, pytest app/backend/tests -q (run from app/backend); (3) ip: bash scripts/ip-check.sh --selftest. No secrets, no paid services.
